Fresh collection read for Beauty & Self-Care (`gid://shopify/Collection/687698313601`) returned `templateSuffix: null`, native image URL `.../4001638579995_R00.jpg?v=1794693427`, and native `altText: Grüne Pipettenflasche mit rotem Etikett auf weissem Hintergrund`. On this exact MAIN theme, `templates/collection.json` assigns the collection's `lux_hero` custom-liquid section before `main`. The saved liquid comment describes the hero as a strip made from the collection's first product photos (with a separate static image only for `schuhe`). Its code chooses up to four `collection.products` featured images; each `` has `alt=""`, and the containing `.lx-hero__bilder` has `aria-hidden="true"`. The hero separately renders the collection title and description. The standard `sections/main-collection.liquid` renders the product grid from `collection.products` and contains no `collection.image` reference. ## Finding The collection image's absence from body `` markup is intentional in the current collection design: the hero is built from product photos, while the native collection image is not part of the visible hero or grid. Its alt text is still stored natively and the image is exposed as `og:image` metadata. This does not establish a template bug. Do not add a collection-image hero solely to surface its alt text. No code change is indicated by this source check. ## Read-only boundary Inspected only `templates/collection.json` and its referenced `sections/main-collection.liquid` on the freshly verified MAIN theme. Shopify reads only; `theme_bash` returned no pending edits. No theme commit, publish, product or collection mutation, GSC/performance read, or index request.
